name: Xiaoshi
source:
Xiaoshi (小事, literally "small things") is a short Chinese-language visual novel about five evenings in a row when someone you like is standing in front of you and you have to say something.

There are no choice menus. You type a line of your own and the game decides what she actually heard — usually not what you meant. Each night lasts about four minutes; she remembers the lines she misheard and brings them up again later, and how the next night begins depends on whether she felt heard the night before.
